thermostat.view_layout: Layout options for the view this card is in

tile.type:
The tile card gives you a quick overview of your entity. The card allows you to toggle the entity and show the more info dialog.
https://www.home-assistant.io/dashboards/tile/
tile.color:
Set the color when the entity is active. By default, the color is based on state, domain, and device_class of your entity. It accepts color token or hex color code.
https://www.home-assistant.io/dashboards/tile/#color
tile.entity:
Entity to show in the tile card
https://www.home-assistant.io/dashboards/tile/#entity
tile.icon_tap_action:
Action taken on icon card tap. By default, it will toggle the entity (if possible), otherwise, show the “more-info” dialog.
https://www.home-assistant.io/dashboards/tile/#icon_tap_action
tile.name:
Overwrites friendly name.
https://www.home-assistant.io/dashboards/tile/#name
tile.show_entity_picture:
If your entity has a picture, it will replace the icon.
ttps://www.home-assistant.io/dashboards/tile/#show_entity_picture
tile.tap_action:
Action taken on card tap. By default, it will show the “more-info” dialog.
https://www.home-assistant.io/dashboards/tile/#tap_action

vertical-stack.type:
The Vertical Stack card allows you to group multiple cards so they always sit in the same column.
https://www.home-assistant.io/lovelace/vertical-stack/
vertical-stack.title:
Title of Stack.
https://www.home-assistant.io/lovelace/vertical-stack/#title
vertical-stack.view_layout: Layout options for the view this card is in

weather-forecast.type:
The Weather Forecast card displays the weather. Very useful to include on interfaces that people display on the wall.
https://www.home-assistant.io/lovelace/weather-forecast/
weather-forecast.entity:
The entity_id of the weather platform to use.
https://www.home-assistant.io/lovelace/weather-forecast/#entity
weather-forecast.name:
Overwrites the friendly name.
https://www.home-assistant.io/lovelace/weather-forecast/#name
weather-forecast.secondary_info_attribute:
Which attribute to display under the temperature.
https://www.home-assistant.io/lovelace/weather-forecast/#secondary_info_attribute
weather-forecast.theme:
Set to any theme within themes.yaml.
https://www.home-assistant.io/lovelace/weather-forecast/#theme
weather-forecast.view_layout: Layout options for the view this card is in

views.badges:
List of entities IDs or badge objects to display as badges. Note that badges do not show when view is in panel mode.
https://www.home-assistant.io/lovelace/dashboards-and-views/#badges
views.cards:
Cards to display in this view.
https://www.home-assistant.io/lovelace/dashboards-and-views/#cards
views.path:
You can link to one view from a card in another view when using cards that support navigation (navigation_path). The string supplied here will be appended to the string /lovelace/ to create the path to the view.
https://www.home-assistant.io/lovelace/dashboards-and-views/#path
views.theme:
Set a separate theme for the view and its cards.
https://www.home-assistant.io/lovelace/dashboards-and-views/#theme
views.title:
The title or name.
https://www.home-assistant.io/lovelace/dashboards-and-views/#title
views.visible:
You can specify the visibility of views as a whole or per-user. (Note: This is only for the display of the tabs. The URL path is still accessible.)
https://www.home-assistant.io/lovelace/dashboards-and-views/#visible
views.type:
The sections view arranges cards in a grid of sections, which can be grouped and rearranged in the dashboard editor.
https://www.home-assistant.io/dashboards/sections/
views.sections:
The sections of the view, each holding a list of cards.
https://www.home-assistant.io/dashboards/sections/#sections
views.max_columns:
The maximum number of section columns to display.
https://www.home-assistant.io/dashboards/sections/#max_columns
views.dense_section_placement:
Fill gaps in the layout by moving sections up, even if this changes their order.
https://www.home-assistant.io/dashboards/sections/#dense_section_placement
